findings.title: GET products 401 response is an object but live OpenAPI declares a product array
findings.expected: Live /v3/api-docs declares an array of ProductDto for GET /api/v1/products HTTP 401. Response body type should match that published contract.
findings.actual: Two unauthenticated GET requests returned HTTP 401 with application/json and {"message":"Unauthorized"}, an object. Cart 401 also references a success model, but its permissive schema does not prove formal invalidity.
findings.impact: Observed product error response fails the documented top-level array constraint. Client deserialization impact is possible, not executed. No authentication bypass observed.
